title: Phone Number Validator
description: Validate and format phone numbers in the browser, with Brazil and E.164 modes, without carrier or WhatsApp lookup or saved data.
metaDescription: Validate and format phone numbers in the browser, with Brazil and E.164 modes, without carrier or WhatsApp lookup or saved data.

form.title: Validate phone number
form.description: Type or paste one phone number to check format, area code, +55, and E.164 structure.

input.title: Phone number
input.label: Phone number
input.privacy: Validation runs in your browser. This tool does not send the phone number to the server.
input.hint: Single-number validation only. Extensions, carrier, WhatsApp, and line existence are not verified.

mode.label: Validation mode
mode.hint: Brazil is the default. Use E.164 to check international structure with a + sign.

share.title: Share
share.description: By default, the link stores only mode and output. The phone number does not enter the URL.
share.includeContent: Include phone number in shared link
share.safe: The current link does not include the typed phone number.
share.publicWarning: Links with a phone number expose it to anyone who receives the URL.
share.tooLong: The phone number is too large for a safe link. The link will include only the content option.

result.title: Result
result.description: The result shows structure and warnings, not line existence, owner, or reachability.
result.emptyDescription: Enter a phone number to start validation.
result.validBrazilDescription: The number has a plausible Brazilian phone format with area code and can be normalized.
result.validInternationalDescription: The number has plausible E.164 structure, but no country or line was looked up.
result.specialDescription: The number looks like a public utility or non-geographic service number, not a common personal contact.
result.syntaxOnly: Local format validation only. Does not query Anatel, nSAPN, carriers, WhatsApp, SMS, active lines, owners, or consent.

outputs.selectedHint: The preferred output changes only the view and may enter the safe link.

input.label: Input
input.pass: The input length and basic content are within the expected range.

characters.label: Characters
characters.pass: Only digits, common separators, and one leading + sign were used.

countryDdd.label: Country and area code
countryDdd.pass: The country, area code, or selected mode is consistent with the input.

length.label: Digit count
length.pass: The digit count matches the selected structure.

localPrefix.label: Local prefix
localPrefix.pass: The first local digit matches expected fixed-line or mobile shapes.

e164.label: E.164
e164.pass: The international output stays within the practical 15-digit limit.

specialService.label: Special service
specialService.pass: No short code or non-geographic service number was detected.

normalization.label: Normalization
normalization.pass: No relevant adjustment was needed beyond reading the text.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.pass: The tool validates in the browser and does not put the phone number in the link by default.

issues.empty: There is no phone number to validate yet.
issues.trimmedWhitespace: Leading or trailing spaces were ignored for validation.
issues.inputTooLong: The input exceeds this tool's practical length limit.
issues.unsupportedCharacters: Remove letters, emoji, slashes, @, <, >, or punctuation outside common phone notation.
issues.unsupportedExtension: An extension was detected. Validation normalizes only the main number and does not include extensions in E.164.
issues.nonAsciiDigits: Use ASCII digits 0 through 9; other digit scripts are not normalized in this version.
issues.misplacedPlus: The + sign must appear at the start of the number.
issues.noDigits: Include digits to validate the phone number.
issues.separatorsIgnored: Spaces, parentheses, dots, and hyphens were ignored for validation.
issues.tooShort: There are too few digits for a complete phone number in this mode.
issues.tooLong: There are too many digits for a complete phone number in this mode.
issues.brCountryCodeWithoutPlus: The Brazil country code 55 appears to be typed without +. Use +55 for E.164.
issues.brDialingPrefix: Prefixes such as 0 or carrier selection were treated as dialing notation, not part of the normalized contact.
issues.brInternationalDialingPrefix: The 00 prefix is international dialing notation. For E.164, prefer the + sign.
issues.brMissingDdd: The local number may be plausible, but a full Brazilian contact number needs an area code.
issues.brInvalidLength: The digit count does not match Brazilian fixed, mobile, or local phone shapes.
issues.brInvalidLocalPrefix: The first local digit does not match the Brazilian shapes expected in this version.
issues.dddNotVerified: The area code was read as two digits, but this tool does not query the Anatel/PGCN table in real time.
issues.brServiceUtility: 1NN codes may be public utility numbers and should not be treated as personal contacts.
issues.brNonGeographic: Prefixes such as 0300, 0303, 0500, 0800, and 0900 are service numbers, not common personal contacts.
issues.missingPlus: In international mode, use + before the country code for valid E.164 notation.
issues.internationalModeRecommended: This country code is not +55. Use international mode to validate E.164 structure only.
issues.e164TooShort: E.164 needs a longer structure to avoid looking like an incomplete code.
issues.e164TooLong: E.164 allows at most 15 digits after the + sign.
issues.e164InvalidCountryCode: An E.164 country code should not start with 0.
issues.internationalStructureOnly: Valid E.164 structure does not prove a specific country, active line, SMS delivery, or WhatsApp.
issues.localValidationOnly: The phone number is not sent, saved, or looked up by this tool.

summary.scope: Scope: local format validation, without carrier, WhatsApp, owner, active line, or consent checks.

kind.brFixed: Type: Brazilian fixed-line or similar number.
kind.brMobile: Type: Brazilian mobile or similar number.

details.title: What this validation covers
details.description: The tool checks offline format and avoids external lookups.

brazil.title: Brazil by default
brazil.description: Reads a two-digit area code plus 8-digit fixed-line or 9-digit mobile access codes.

e164.title: E.164 structure
e164.description: Checks the + sign, digits, and 15-digit limit for international numbers.

noLookup.title: No lookup
noLookup.description: Does not check carrier, portability, WhatsApp, owner, address, or active line.

privacy.title: Safe link
privacy.description: The phone number enters a link only when you explicitly check the share-content option.

privacy.question: Is the phone number sent to the server?
privacy.answer: No. Validation runs in the browser. The phone number enters a URL only if you enable the option to include it in the link.

existence.question: Does this validator confirm that the line exists?
existence.answer: No. It checks format and structure. It does not confirm an active line, owner, account, SMS delivery, or call completion.

whatsappCarrier.question: Does the validator check WhatsApp or carrier?
whatsappCarrier.answer: No. There is no WhatsApp, carrier, portability, Anatel, nSAPN, external API, or contact database lookup.

dddE164.question: What is the difference between area code, +55, and E.164?
dddE164.answer: The area code identifies a national numbering area. +55 is Brazil's country code. E.164 is the international notation with + and up to 15 digits.

missingDdd.question: Why does a number without area code show a warning?
missingDdd.answer: A local number may have a plausible shape, but a complete Brazilian contact number needs an area code.

specialSharing.question: Can I validate extensions, 0800 numbers, or share a filled phone number?
specialSharing.answer: Extensions trigger a warning and do not enter E.164. 0800 and similar numbers are treated as services. Share a phone number in the link only when everyone with the URL may see it.

seo.about: The phone number validator checks one number directly in the browser. It identifies Brazilian area-code formats, +55, mobile and fixed-line shapes, local-only numbers, dialing prefixes, and international E.164 structure, always without querying carriers or external databases.
seo.howToUseTitle: How to validate phone numbers online
seo.howToUse: Type or paste a phone number, choose Brazil or International/E.164, and review the status, warnings, and formatted, E.164, or digits-only outputs. A plausible format does not prove that the line exists, is active, belongs to someone, or has WhatsApp.
